prayerExcerpt.en-US: Ask St. Laurence to vouchsafe you such a sense of the sufficiency of God that you too may fly to Him and be at rest.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Pedi a São Lourenço que se digne conceder-vos tal senso da suficiência de Deus que também vós voeis a Ele e nele encontreis repouso.

meta.face: A Venetian of about seventy-four, CLEAN-SHAVEN, with a sallow, parchment-pale complexion and a very LONG, GAUNT face after Gentile Bellini's portrait — a high forehead SLOPING back under the skullcap, a MASSIVE, HIGH-BRIDGED, strongly HOOKED nose, SMALL, keen, heavy-lidded dark eyes set DEEP in their sockets under a jutting brow ridge, a SHARP cheekbone over a deeply SUNKEN cheek, THIN, tightly closed lips, and a LONG, strongly JUTTING chin under a lean jaw; no hair showing; the gaze level and inward. Not the youngish, fine-nosed charles_borromeo in cardinal's red, nor the white-haired, bearded alphonsus_liguori.
meta.basis: Gentile Bellini's profile portrait (1465, Venice), made within ten years of his death, shows the gaunt old face with the great hooked nose, deep-set eye and jutting chin, the black skullcap and white habit. The card follows it closely.
